The '''Dantooine Enclave starship''' was a small [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

==Characteristics==
The vessel was capable of carrying at least four passengers. It had two wings attached to a central chassis, and was supported on landing by multiple landing struts, allowing for ventral disembarkation.

==History==
This ship was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], in particular the [[Jedi Enclave|Dantooine Enclave]], during the period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. In [[3993 BBY]], it was used by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Guun Han Saresh]], [[Shaela Nuur]], [[Duron Qel-Droma]] and [[Cale Berkona]] to return from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] following their successful [[Cleansing of Tatooine|mission]] to eradicate the [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]] there. The same crew&mdash;minus Berkona who was recovering from injuries&mdash;then traveled in the starship to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where they attempted unsuccessfully to destroy that planet's terentatek population.<ref name="S&L">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>

After its owners' demise on Korriban, the ship was later present on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] in [[3963 BBY]]. It was berthed adjacent to [[Pad 223]], where the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] con-artist [[Marn Hierogryph]] was delivered the stolen provisioning ship, the ''[[Little Bivoli]]''.<ref name="K13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This ship was drawn by [[Dustin Weaver]] in both its appearances. He confirmed it is the same ship on the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] forums.<ref name="Forums">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=boards/viewtopic.php?t=11233&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=60|thread=KotOR #15 -- Do you smell something burning?|nobackup=1}}</ref>
